mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_query_stats ( query_text, query_text_normalized, search_count, result_count_total, click_count, last_result_count, last_search_time, trend_score, hot_score ) VALUES ( #{queryText}, #{normalizedQuery}, 1, #{resultCount}, 0, #{resultCount}, NOW(), 0, 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE query_text = VALUES(query_text), search_count = search_count + 1, result_count_total = result_count_total + VALUES(result_count_total), last_result_count = VALUES(last_result_count), last_search_time = NOW()
